episodes.synopsis: The Demon King's army continues to fight against humans. Ike, the leader of the Undying Brigade, is the grandson of the great magician Romberg. Despite being respected, Ike hides his human identity, fearing the disaster it would cause should it be known.
episodes.title: Ike, Commander of the Undying Brigade

episodes.synopsis: Ike and Satie attempt to gather information about the next human attack. Meanwhile, Alistair from the White Rose Knights is already gathering her troops behind him...
episodes.title: Alistair, Leader of the White Rose Knights

episodes.synopsis: A traitor is revealed in the Demon Lord's army, and Ike begins to hunt them down...
episodes.title: Traitor

episodes.synopsis: Dairokuten demands Cefiro fight a duel with one of the other Corps commanders. But Cefiro has something else in mind...
episodes.title: Duel

episodes.synopsis: Ike battles the treacherous Basteo and his undead legions.
episodes.title: Ambition

episodes.synopsis: Ike seeks the aid of another race for the upcoming battle with the humans.
episodes.title: Dwarf King

episodes.synopsis: The Alliance of Kings begins their assault on Ike's forces.
episodes.title: War Begins

episodes.synopsis: Ike begins his counterattack to defend Ivalias from the human army.
episodes.title: The Final Battle at Ivalias

episodes.synopsis: Ike goes to negotiate with the Trade Federation for badly-needed supplies.
episodes.title: Negotiations

episodes.synopsis: When Satie is kidnapped by pirates, Ike goes all-out to rescue her.
episodes.title: Pirates

episodes.synopsis: Cefiro is defeated, and Ike rushes to her aid.
episodes.title: Cefiro is Defeated

episodes.synopsis: Ike arrives to save Cefiro, and uses a cunning plan and new weapons in his battle against the brilliant enemy general.
episodes.title: General E. Rudle
